children: Technology services company Lleida.net (BME:LLN, EPA:ALLLN) took part in ANDICOM 2026, held from September 1 to 4 at the Centro de Convenciones Las Américas in Cartagena de Indias, Colombia, under the theme "Unleashing the Power of AI".

Organised by CINTEL, ANDICOM ranks among Latin America's most significant business and technology congresses. This year's 41st edition turned the spotlight on artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, connectivity, and digital regulation, all seen as key drivers of competitiveness and innovation for companies and governments alike. The congress drew delegations from more than 40 countries, with the European Union attending as the guest of honour and welcomed over 6,000 attendees in total.

Lleida.net ran its own stand (2.4) throughout the event, showcasing its full suite of digital trust solutions. On show were registered electronic notification services via email, SMS, and WhatsApp; electronic signature offerings, including digital signature certificates and identity verification through codes and biometrics; and document process automation, alongside the company's electronic document management system (SGDEA).

"As artificial intelligence and automation continue to advance at a pace, digital trust matters more than ever," said Giovanni Silva, Colombia Sales Manager at Lleida.net. "At Lleida.net, we work to ensure every notification, signature or document process carries the legal validity that Colombian businesses need to operate securely."

For Lleida.net, ANDICOM 2026 provided a strategic platform to strengthen its standing across Colombia and Latin America, while opening the door to new business opportunities and partnerships with clients, technology providers, and organisations in the public and private sectors. The company's involvement in the congress reflects its continued commitment to innovation and secure digital transformation in the region.

Lleida.net also joined a programme of networking sessions and business meetings as part of a trade mission organised by ACCIÓ, the Catalan government's trade and investment agency, running alongside ANDICOM 2026 with the aim of generating commercial opportunities in the region.
